                           P R O C E E D I N G S

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Senate will please come to order.

                            I ask everyone present to please

                 Allegiance.

                            (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

                 the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    In view

                 of we have no clergy with us today, I ask we

                 all join in bowing our heads for a moment of

                 silence.

                            (Whereupon, the assemblage

                 respected a moment of silence.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Reading

                 of the Journal.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,

                 Tuesday, May 6, the Senate met pursuant to

                 adjournment.  The Journal of Monday, May 5,

                 was read and approved.  On motion, Senate

                 adjourned.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Without

                 objection, the Journal stands approved as

                 read.

                            Senator Farley.

                            SENATOR FARLEY:    Thank you, Madam

                 President.

                            On behalf of Senator Hoffmann, on

                 page 29 I offer the following amendments to

                            Senator Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Madam President,

                 I believe there are substitutions at the desk.

                 If we could make them at this time.

                 Secretary will read.

                 Senator Nozzolio moves to discharge, from the

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Substitutions ordered.

                            Senator Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Yes, Madam

                 President, there will be an immediate meeting

                 of the Insurance Committee in the Majority

                 Conference Room.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Immediate meeting of the Insurance Committee

                 in the Majority Conference Room.

                            Senator Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    If we could go

                 to the noncontroversial reading of the

                 calendar.



                                                        2432



                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 122, by Senator McGee, Senate Print 1262, an

                 act to amend the Vehicle and Traffic Law, in

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 35.  Nays,

                 487, by Senator Skelos, Senate Print 2841, an

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 37.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 596, by the Senate Committee on Rules, Senate

                 Print Number 4864A, an act to amend the Tax

                 Law, in relation to authorizing the County of



                                                        2436



                 Sullivan.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 6.  This

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 620, by Senator McGee, Senate Print 4873, an

                 act to amend Chapter 533 of the Laws of 1993,

                 amending the Vehicle and Traffic Law and the

                 Correction Law.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 3.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Senator

                 Krueger.



                                                        2437



                            SENATOR LIZ KRUEGER:    I just rise

                 to explain my vote.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Senator

                 Krueger, to explain her vote.

                            SENATOR LIZ KRUEGER:    Thank you.

                            I will be voting yes on this bill,

                 but I also feel it's important to mention that

                 it is today the 30th anniversary of the

                 Rockefeller Drug Laws.

                            And while this bill is specifically

                 related to driving license suspension and drug

                 use, which I certainly can support, I again

                 highlight for this floor and for this chamber

                 that it is now 30 years since we passed the

                 Rockefeller Drug Laws, and it is way past time

                 for us to get to work to evaluate the fact

                 that these are failed laws, that we are

                 putting people into prison for extended

                 periods of time for low-level, nonviolent drug

                 offenses.

                            And while I would argue that it is

                 not too strict to take away a driver's

                 license, the right to drive, for people who

                 are guilty of using drugs and driving, I do

                 object to the fact that we are not dealing



                                                        2438



                 with the bigger problems for drug laws in this

                 state.

                            Thank you very much.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Senator

                 Krueger will be recorded in the affirmative.

                            Announce the results.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 43.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 665, substituted earlier today by the Assembly

                 Committee on Rules, Assembly Print Number

                 8353, an act to amend the Public Authorities

                 not a 138, Senator Duane.  Would you care

                 to --

                            SENATOR DUANE:    Either that, or I

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Are you

                 suggesting 133, perhaps?

                            SENATOR DUANE:    I am.  I am.

                 Thank you, Madam President.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    So 122,

                 133 --

                            SENATOR DUANE:    390 and 492.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    -- 390

                 and 492.

                            SENATOR DUANE:    Bingo.

                 Secretary will record.

                            SENATOR MONTGOMERY:    Yes, Madam

                                                        2440



                 be recorded in the negative on Calendar 122.

                 there being no further business to come before

                 the Senate, I move we adjourn until Monday,

                 May 12th, at 3:00 p.m., intervening days being



                                                        2441



                 legislative days.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 May 12th, at 3:00 p.m.  The intervening days
